reviews.title: Great for typing
reviews.comment: As a software developer, I type a lot and am very pleased with the quality of switches in this keyboard.  The customization options for the color and brightness of the backlighting is also great. I purchased a refurbished one for half the price and it is in great/new condition.  The only complaint I have is the placement of the “cherry” key. I think it would have been better to place it to the right of F12 instead to the left of F1 because I often hit F1 when I intend to hit F2.
reviews.author: Jamie
